messages:
Cam (product): Heads-up: Sales back from two customers asking for a single-pane observability view that ties cost, traces, and error analytics together. They want a clear runbook to answer: "did this invoice charge correspond to these high-error requests?"
Dara (eng): High-level options: (1) enrich dashboard with per-route cost and a lightweight trace handle, (2) push full-span retention for opted-in tenants, or (3) hybrid: pointers + on-demand rehydrate. Each has perf/econ tradeoffs.
Ollie (sre): Ops note: always-on full-span retention raises steady-state storage and index pressure. Hybrid approach seems safest: write compact handles for errors (cheap) + a queued rehydrate path for exports. Need quotas and throttles.
Sam (acct): Customers want CSV that links invoice line -> requests -> error traces. If we can supply a handle->invoice mapping that's enough for many audits. For full exports they want SLAs and a billing credit/backstop. We'll likely gate that behind a contract.
Rin (design): UX: add a "Billing & Visibility" panel in workspace: top routes by cost, toggle to show error rate, and an error row affordance "handle / request link". If full trace is not present show "Request reconstruct" with estimated ETA & cost. Keep it unobtrusive.
Cam (product): Proposed scope for next sprint: A) Billing & Visibility MVP (top 10 routes, CSV export), B) error-handle write-on-error + index, C) rehydrate/export job queue as opt-in paid feature. Launch criteria: CSV maps invoices to handles, handle pill displayed on error rows for beta tenants, and audit log for any export.
Dara (eng): Rough estimates: A) telemetry rollup + UI export ~1.5 sprints. B) handle index writes + API ~1 sprint. C) rehydrate queue + redaction/export ~2 sprints + a perf spike. Backfill for historical errors will add extra work.
Ollie (sre): Ops checklist: per-tenant export quota, concurrent job cap (default 3), background rehydrate throttle, immutable audit entries for each export, and alerts if rehydrate cost >2x baseline. Also add a revocation flow for exports.
Sam (acct): Pricing suggestion: free CSV & handles; paid tier for guaranteed handles + priority rehydrate (SLA 30s for 95% in canary). We'll draft contract language + export penalty/credits. Legal must review PII/redaction obligations.
Rin (design): UX edge cases: when reconstruct fails show clear message and an option to queue a retry. Show provenance: when handle was created, sampling status, and export cost estimate. Keep the error list snappy.
Dara (eng): Implementation notes: handle can be deterministic short-hash (tenant + request-id) stored in compact index. Rehydrate will read ingest segments; if segments aged out return audited failure. Plan to cache rehydrates for 24h. Need spike dataset to validate 30s SLA feasibility.
Cam (product): Risks: cost spikes, PII exposure, and customer confusion when data missing. Mitigations: opt-in gating, redaction pipeline prior to export, canary on Dedicated for one customer, and clear UX messaging.
Dara (eng): Action items: I'll open RFC with data model (handle schema), CSV mapping schema, API for rehydrate/export, and perf/cost estimates. Also propose canary plan with one committed tenant.
Ollie (sre): I'll draft ops runbook and SLOs for canary.
Rin (design): I'll drop mocks for Billing & Visibility panel and error-row handle treatment.
Sam (acct): I'll coordinate with legal about export terms and draft pricing tiers.
